items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I don't know his name, but Alexander's daddy, that's where he gets the name, they call him Tats.

ctx.x: There must have been quite a few around that we never got to hear.
Oh yeah, they had a fella, I don't know his name, but Alexander's daddy, that's where he gets the name, they call him Tats. That's from his daddy, he used to call him Taton. Oh yeah.
What does that mean? What does that mean?
